answer: A concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond before its attestations count, and influence tracks locked stake, not key count. Fake agents buy nothing unless each is funded. Audits sample attestations as a gauge samples a river; a node caught double-signing forfeits its bond to the harbor treasury. The attacker pays for every forged identity plus slashed deposits, so cost rises with the stake needed to win. The cheap fable of endless identities becomes a capital bet no Sybil actor can repeat.
